title: Local Stochastic Rough Volatility: Pathwise Filtering and the Conditional Density Equation
abstract: arXiv:2607.27588v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: This article studies the conditional-density equation and its pathwise transformation in local stochastic rough volatility models, with rough Heston (rHeston) as the main explicit example. Under the stated common-filtration, measurability, predictability and spatial-regularity assumptions, we show that the Ito-Wentzell random-PDE reduction of the conditional density SPDE remains valid under local stochastic rough volatility. After fixing a common-environment realization and the associated stochastic flow, the transformed equation becomes a deterministic PDE with path-dependent coefficients. This yields a pathwise Fokker--Planck formulation that connects naturally with Rao--Blackwellized calibration. In the pure rough Heston case, the transformed coefficients simplify and the conditional density admits an explicit lognormal form.

translated_title: 局部随机粗糙波动率：路径滤波与条件密度方程
translated_abstract: 本文研究了局部随机粗糙波动率模型中的条件密度方程及其路径变换，以粗糙赫斯顿模型为主要显式示例。在所述共同滤波、可测性、可预测性和空间正则性假设下，我们证明了条件密度SPDE的伊藤-温策尔随机偏微分方程约化在局部随机粗糙波动率下仍然有效。在固定共同环境实现及相关随机流后，变换后的方程变为具有路径依赖系数的确定性偏微分方程。这产生了路径福克-普朗克表述，与 Rao-Blackwellized 校准自然联系。在纯粗糙赫斯顿情形下，变换系数简化，条件密度具有显式对数正态形式。
tldr: 本文提出并验证了局部随机粗糙波动率模型中条件密度方程的路径滤波变换，将其简化为确定性偏微分方程，并在纯粗糙赫斯顿情形下获得显式解。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes a pathwise transformation of the conditional density equation in local stochastic rough volatility models, reducing it to a deterministic PDE with explicit solutions in the pure rough Heston case.
